articles.title: Minister Raksha Khadse calls for stronger pathways for women in Indian sports

articles.title: Congress demands Crime Branch probe and bandh over minor girl case
articles.summary: The Odisha Pradesh Congress Committee demanded a Crime Branch investigation on Saturday into the alleged rape and murder of a minor girl in Balasore district. Officials hope this action will address growing concerns regarding the sensitive case.

articles.title: Indian gangsters Himanshu Bhau and Neeraj Faridpuria detained in Las Vegas

articles.title: Kapil Sibal defends democratic government change against Mohan Bhagwat comments
articles.summary: Independent leader Kapil Sibal criticized Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh chief Mohan Bhagwat at a press conference. Sibal argued that calls for regime change in India are peaceful and democratic. He accused the administration of stifling dissent and misusing legal systems against political opponents. Furthermore, he expressed deep concern regarding foreign interference and territorial integrity issues affecting Arunachal Pradesh.

articles.title: Bengaluru police arrest Delhi man over controversial sting video

Investigators state the accused claimed he uploaded the footage following instructions from a Janata Dal Secular social media team associate. Police are continuing their investigation into the matter to determine further details about the upload.

articles.title: Shooters tracked media coverage to evade police after attacking Tiger Shroff
articles.summary: Three suspects who shot at actor Tiger Shroff in Mumbai used real-time media updates from handlers to evade police. The October 18 attack injured two people and sparked a multi-state manhunt. Police arrested the trio in Rajasthan on October 19. Investigators are now probing the weapons supply chain and searching for wanted gangster Anil Pandit.

articles.title: Sajjan Singh Yadav To Succeed Atal Dulloo As J&K chief secretary
articles.summary: Jammu, Oct 24: Senior IAS officer Sajjan Singh Yadav, a 1995-batch AGMUT cadre officer, is set to replace Atal Dulloo as the chief secretary of Jammu and Kashmir, according to an order issued by the Union Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA). articles.title: Rajasthan votes in first phase of panchayat elections across 16 districts
articles.summary: A total of 16,795 candidates are contesting sarpanch posts, while elections are also being held for 28,682 ward panch seats. Voting will continue until 6 pm, after which counting will begin, with results expected by late evening. The elections are being held in Ajmer, Alwar, Barmer, Bhilwara, Bikaner, Dungarpur, Jaipur, Jhalawar, Jodhpur, Kota, Nagaur, Pali, Phalodi, Rajsamand, Sirohi and Udaipur.

articles.title: Weakening democratic checks in India threaten public trust and youth future
articles.summary: Over the past decade, the weakening of institutional checks in India has raised serious questions about accountability and democratic safeguards. This fallout threatens public trust and the future of the nation's youth. The erosion extends far beyond politics and education, impacting overall societal stability and governance structures as democratic safeguards continue to face growing challenges.

articles.title: Indian youth movement challenges Prime Minister Narendra Modi over voter rolls
articles.summary: Formed in May 2026, India's youth-led Cockroach Janta Party is protesting in Delhi and Mumbai to demand the removal of the chief election commissioner. Protesters are challenging Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the Bharatiya Janata Party over the deletion of 130 million voter names. The movement aims to protect democratic rights amid widespread anger over high graduate unemployment.

articles.title: Good news for passengers: Chhattisgarh to get new railway projects; 100 additional trains

articles.title: Delhi Police Transfers All Protest First Information Reports To Crime Branch

articles.summary: Amir Shokeen, the Delhi-based content creator apprehended for hurling racial abuse at a Tripura youth, was remanded to one-day judicial custody in a case registered at Sadar Bazar Police Station. articles.title: Indian Union Muslim League Promises Action Over Doha Office Heist

articles.title_hi: HYBE ने भारत को आगे बढ़ाने, HYBE अमेरिका निवेश के साथ वैश्विक विकास को आगे बढ़ाया
articles.summary_hi: "HYBE की वैश्विक प्रणाली और स्थानीय भारतीय विशेषज्ञों की रचनात्मक ऊर्जा का संयोजन सकारात्मक तालमेल पैदा करेगा।" इस सप्ताह लॉन्च किया गया एक ऑडिशन पोर्टल 2005 और 2011 के बीच जन्मी लड़कियों के लिए खुला है। आवेदक गायन, रैप, नृत्य, अभिनय या मॉडलिंग में कौशल दिखा सकते हैं। कार्यक्रम को "आपकी प्रतिभा, हमारा वैश्विक मंच" टैगलाइन के साथ प्रचारित किया जा रहा है।
articles.title_hinglish: HYBE ne bharata ko aage badhaाne, HYBE amerika nivesha ke satha vaishvika vikasa ko aage badhaाya
articles.summary_hinglish: "HYBE ki vaishvika pranali aura sthaniya bharatiya visheshajnyon ki rachanatmaka oorja ka sanyojana sakaratmaka talamela paida karega।" isa saptaha loncha kiya gaya eka ऑdishana portala 2005 aura 2011 ke bicha janmi ladakiyon ke lie khula hai। aavedaka gayan, raip, nrity, abhinaya ya modalinga men kaushala dikha sakate hain। karyakrama ko "aapaki pratibh, hamara vaishvika mancha" taigalaina ke satha pracharita kiya ja raha hai।

articles.title: C-DAC, Bank of India partner to develop indigenous quantum technologies for banking
articles.summary: New Delhi: The Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) and Bank of India (BOI) have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to explore indigenous quantum technologies and other emerging technologies for banking and financial services. The MoU, signed on October 22, establishes a framework for joint research and development, pilot projects, proof-of-concept initiatives, technology demonstrations and capacity-building programmes.

articles.summary_hinglish: da diplomaita padhaेn, eshiya-prashanta ko janen, rajya ki bhajapa sarakara ne dharmika aura anushthanika prathaon ko lagu karane ke lie isa tyohara ki dharmanirapeksha-sanskritika vishishtata ko chhina liy, jo bangaliyon ke lie abhishapa hai। durga puja utsava ke anta men visarjana ke bada devi durga ki eka murti nadi para tairati hai।
